تنتزعن (form VIII)
# تَنْتَزِعْنَ (tantaziʕna) /tan.ta.ziʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# تُنْتَزَعْنَ (tuntazaʕna) /tun.ta.zaʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
